page.overview:
Who is Nanofigure?

The most consistent use of nanofigures is as statues in the Architecture theme.

The earliest version of a micro or nanofigure in LEGO history was the HO scale figure released in 1271 Traffic Police in 1956. The microfigure started appearing as pieces in LEGO board games in 2009. A nanofigure was required in 2015 for larger collector sets where ones in the regular Minifigure scale would have not been possible.
